training.selection: minimum neutral-temperature dev NLL at steps 11,22,...,198
training.trainable: head,type_emb,scorer only; encoder and action head frozen
training.epochs_note: 522 decision sequences ->66 accumulation windows/epoch; 198 successful updates is about 3 epochs. Overflow windows consume examples and may extend the final epoch.

conditions.E0: original checkpoint with runtime-clamped original temperatures

analysis.interpretation: Exploratory single-seed estimates on 89 heuristic source groups; intervals conditional on the fixed fitted models and do not include training/calibration uncertainty; multiple comparisons are descriptive, not corrected significance tests.
analysis.test_access: training and temperatures locked before E0/E1/E2/E3 test evaluations; no settings selected using test

timing.note: all 186 test decisions once per timed stage; short utterances under max_len512, not 512-token stress. GPUs not exclusively reserved.

limits: public human-localized alarm subset, not naturally occurring customer-service logs
upstream intent-match evidence, no independent local human review
choice/noul share source text and group; not 942 independent utterances
base model exposure to MASSIVE/SLURP unknown
single seed, single task, no general Chinese improvement claim
purpose: Fixed experiment settings; the reproduction script binds actual paths, hashes and time before predictions.
